introduction: Sergei Parajanov (1924-1990), filmmaker of Armenian origin, poet, non-conformist visual artist of genius remains a legendary figure of opposition to the Soviet regime which landed him in prison, notably for homosexuality for around ten years.A pilgrimage to Yerevan to his last house which became his museum by a French director of Russian origin who admires his work gradually transforms into a mystical experience in search of the spirit of the Master. An invocation crossed by his films, his collages, his friend the Russian filmmaker Andreï Tarkovsky, the director's grandmother and other visions while outside the war rumbles between Russia and Ukraine, Azerbaijan and Armenia.
